title: The folder walk reads `cd "$(cmd)"` as a change of folder
why: Lane cd-var-dir-unread (#2379), 23:15 CST Nov 8: `cd "$(cmd)"` keeps the folder from before the segment, because the `)` pop in dir_before_segment (hooks/guard_core.py) restores `where` from the saved copy. Same cause as #2379's paren-pop fix for variables. Main does the same.
note: Also noted: the literal twin `ls M &&\n cd A` reads as run (same on main). Red case first.
